div.div:
Security:
- ALB Security Groups allow only
port 443 and 80 for IPs 0.0.0.0/0
- React App and NodeJS API security groups
allow only the ALB on Port 80 and 443
- Go API allows only NodeJs API on Port 80 and 443
- Network Policies to have NodeJs and React Public
and Go allow only NodeJs Pod
